fact: The World Bank's aide memoire for its 27 October to 7 November 2025 mission says the Irembo 3.0 low-code/no-code platform is fully deployed, with Rwanda Coding Academy graduates supporting service onboarding alongside the core project team, and that 907 government employees were trained, about half to industry certification.
title: Rwanda: Digital Acceleration Project (P173373) Implementation Support Mission October 27 - November 7, 2025 Aide Memoire
